newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at thinly lower levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at thinly lower levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at thinly lower levels on Friday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus ten barges on Thursday.
- Eight barges, Illinois River, two each week of July, bid 95 percent of tariff, no comparison, no offer.
- Four barges, Osceola-Cape Girardeau, Mississippi River, one each week of September, $500 switched, bid 132-1/2 percent, no comparison, no offer.
- Four barges, Illinois River, one each week of October, bid 207-1/2 percent, down five percentage points from May 7, no offer.
- Four barges, Illinois River, one each week of December, bid 150 percent, down five percentage points from May 7, no offer.
